{{Quote|Lieutenant Planchet's been deep undercover on Malastare for the last year.|S'ree Bonard|<ref name="Target" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jez Planchet]] went on a deep undercover '''mission''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. He was captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and tortured for information before being [[Death/Legends|executed]] by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot.<ref name="Target" />
